challenges.rationale: The gene is highly LoF-intolerant (pLI 1.0, LOEUF 0.31). Claiming safety based on a lack of Mendelian disease ignores strong selection pressure against LoF variants.
High constraint (pLI 1.0) suggests LoF is deleterious. Absence of Mendelian disease reports does not equate to safety when the gene is under strong purifying selection.
